verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents a RESTful API over much of its data, including a list-all-items endpoint that filters by level, environment and status and supports pagination. It also documents managed account and project access tokens with scopes, such as a post_client_item-only token, and community discussion confirms read-scoped project tokens exist. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of an item update endpoint (status, owner), an endpoint for fetching raw occurrences/events, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.
